value.rationale: Excess kurtosis is the natural scale-free non-Gaussianity diagnostic used in the motivating trapped active-particle literature. The full two-parameter sign diagram uncovers a sharp u=4/3 threshold for position and a universal single crossover for velocity, unlike isolated examples or purely algebraic restatements; asymptotic normalized limits give further physically interpretable structure. These claims do not assert mode numbers.
